spec.material: the lesson note for one step of a lesson: what the teacher explains, in order, with worked examples, questions for the class and what stays on the board
spec.audience: the teacher who will teach this lesson to the class
requirements: Write for the teacher, to teach from: the mathematics to explain, in order, never a script to read out and never only headings.
Write what is to be taught, never a record of a lesson already taught.
Every step has substantive teaching points that state the mathematics, with the numbers or symbols themselves.
Every step has questions for the class with their expected answers, at the size the step's objective names.
Every step ends with what stays on the board, in one or two lines.
Every worked example and every answer is mathematically correct, with each line of working justified.

parts.name: teaching_points
parts.description: What to explain, in the order to explain it: each item states one definition, rule, property, fact or instance of the idea in full, with the numbers or symbols themselves. Three to six for a concept or procedure step, two to four for an intro or evaluation step

parts.name: figures
parts.description: Labelled drawings the class copies, in the order the teaching points use them: for a construction, one drawing for each stage

fields.name: caption
fields.description: What the drawing shows, naming its labelled points

fields.name: drawing
fields.description: One tikzpicture environment that draws it, with the same labels

parts.name: worked_examples
parts.description: Graded examples, each solved line by line, for a step that works problems

fields.name: solution
fields.description: The solution, one line of working at a time

fields.name: working
fields.description: One line of the working, in LaTeX between $ signs; plain text in a lesson that does not calculate, such as naming kinds of words

fields.name: commentary
fields.description: Why this line follows, in one short sentence

parts.name: questions_for_the_class
parts.description: Questions the teacher asks the class in this step, of the kind the step teaches and at the size its objective names, each with the answer the class should reach

fields.name: expected_answer
fields.description: The answer the class should reach, with the working where there is any

parts.name: on_the_board
parts.description: What stays on the board and in the pupils' books: the rule or definition in its shortest correct form, one or two lines
